apikeys_welcome: Welcome to {name}. Create your first key to connect an agent.
start_connect_intro: With Claude Code; an API key, created under My API keys after logging in, is needed only for sources that are not public:
start_connect_other: Other clients and the HTTP routes:
start_connect_key: Creating an API key shows this command with the key filled in:
query_nothing_found: Nothing found for “{question}”. Try other words.
query_none_fit: {count} hits found, but none fits the token budget: raise it.
query_skipped: {count} more hits did not fit the token budget.
query_raw: Raw answer, as an agent gets it
field_path: Path in the repository (empty for the whole repository)
field_exclusions: Exclusions: glob patterns relative to the repository root, one per line
field_schedule: Schedule: cron expression with five fields, empty for the global one ({schedule})
field_paused: Paused: polling skips this source, only "Sync now" syncs it
field_token_stored: Access token (stored; leave empty to keep it)
field_token_entered: Access token (entered; leave empty to keep it)
setup_intro: The setup token is in the server log. Choose one of the two ways.
setup_new_lead: Choose this for a new instance: you create the first admin account and add the sources afterwards.
password_lead: Changing it logs out every other session; this one stays logged in.
password_changed: Password changed. Every other session was logged out.
password_none_reset: Your account has no password: you log in through an identity provider. To set one, have a link sent to your address.
password_none_ask_admin: Your account has no password: you log in through an identity provider. To set one, ask an admin for a link.
apikeys_created: Key for {name} created. Copy it now: it is not shown again.
apikeys_lead_before: An agent sends its key in the header
apikeys_lead_after: ; the command that connects it is under
apikeys_error_scope: Choose all sources or at least one.
admin_all_fine: Every source is synced without errors or warnings.
admin_polling_paused: polling paused; only "Sync now" syncs this source
admin_polling_paused_never_synced: polling paused, never synced; only "Sync now" syncs this source
admin_fix_path: Correct "Path in the repository" under Settings, or leave it empty for the whole repository.
admin_fix_branch: Check "Branch" under Settings: the branch may have been renamed or deleted.
admin_fix_access: Use "Test connection" under Settings: renew the access token, or give it access to this repository.
admin_fix_unreachable: Check the Git URL under Settings. If it is right, the Git server cannot be reached from grimoire; "Sync now" tries again.
admin_fix_deadline: The source takes too long to index: if the error names a page, have it split; otherwise narrow the source with "Path in the repository" or exclusions, or ask the operator to raise INDEXING_DEADLINE_MINUTES.
admin_fix_aborted: Indexing stopped, usually for lack of memory: if the error names a page, have it split; otherwise narrow the source with "Path in the repository" or exclusions, or ask the operator for more memory.
admin_fix_no_page: No page was indexed, so the previous index stays; the reason above is the last one. Fix what it names: the Markdown or a file name in the repository, or "Path in the repository" and the exclusions under Settings when the path holds no .md file. The next commit, or saving the settings, syncs again.
admin_fix_unknown: Check the settings and the sync history of the source; "Sync now" tries again.
admin_fix_redirect: Enter the clone URL of the repository under Settings, usually ending in .git; "Test connection" names the address the Git server redirects to.
admin_fix_forbidden: grimoire may not connect to this Git server: ask the operator to add its host to GIT_ALLOWED_HOSTS, or correct the Git URL under Settings.
admin_fix_no_address: The host name of the Git URL does not resolve: check it for typos under Settings. If it is right, ask the operator whether grimoire can resolve internal names.
sync_error_path: The path does not exist in the repository.
sync_error_branch: The branch was not found in the repository.
sync_error_unreachable: The Git server could not be reached.
sync_error_redirect: The Git server redirects this URL elsewhere.
sync_error_forbidden: grimoire may not connect to this Git server.
sync_error_no_address: The host name of the Git server does not resolve.
slug_change_source_effects_short: Changes every snippet ID and agent URL of this source.
list_search_sources: Search by name, slug or description
list_no_match: Nothing matches the search and filters.
source_polling_paused: paused; only "Sync now" syncs this source
source_section_repository_lead: Where grimoire reads the documentation from: the branch, and in it the folder that holds the Markdown files.
source_section_access_lead: Only for a repository that is not public: a read-only token of the Git host, never a password.
source_token_github: Fine-grained personal access token for the repository,
source_token_forgejo: Access token with read access to repositories
error_source_slug_taken: A source with the slug "{slug}" already exists.
error_path: The path is relative to the repository root and may not contain "..".
error_exclusion_too_long: An exclusion may have at most {max} characters per line.
error_exclusion_braces: An exclusion may have at most {max} groups in curly braces.
error_source_changed: Someone else changed this source while it was being saved. Reload the page and save again.
error_token_other_server: The Git URL points to another server: enter the token again or remove it.
error_token_damaged: The entered access token could not be read back. Enter it again.
error_stored_token_unreadable: The stored access token cannot be decrypted with the current key. Enter the token again or remove it.
error_git_url_https: The Git URL must start with https://.
error_git_url_credentials: Enter the username and token in their own fields, not in the Git URL.
auth_wrong_setup_token: Wrong setup token. It is in the server log.
auth_password_too_short: The password needs at least {min} characters.
auth_new_password_too_short: The new password needs at least {min} characters.
auth_blocked: Too many failed logins. Try again later.
error_name_too_long: The name may have at most {max} characters.
error_slug_empty: The name needs a letter or digit to make a slug from.
error_slug_rule: The slug may contain lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most {max} characters, e.g. auth-service.
error_slug_confirmation: Type the current slug {slug} to confirm.
slug_change_source_effects: The slug {slug} is part of the ID of every snippet of this source and of its agent URLs, such as /sources/{slug}. Changing it changes all of them: IDs and URLs that agents or their configuration have stored stop working. The new IDs apply at once.
slug_changed: Slug changed. The new IDs apply at once.
access_refused: Access refused, or there is no repository at this URL: {detail}
access_unreachable: The Git server cannot be reached: {detail}
error_git_host_refused: The server may not connect to {host}. If it is your organisation's Git server, ask the person running grimoire to add it to GIT_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
settings_syncs_paused_hint: No source is checked for new commits until you resume. “Sync now” on a source’s page still syncs that source. Sources can also be paused one by one in their settings; resuming here leaves those paused.
export_lead: Downloads the sources, users, API keys and settings of this instance as one file, to import into an empty instance. Pages come back there with the first sync of each source; sessions, sync history and queries without results are not exported. The file is imported on the setup page of a new, empty instance.
export_warning: The file contains the access token of every source, encrypted with the passphrase you enter here. Nobody can recover a lost passphrase: without it the file cannot be imported. Keep the file like a password and delete it once imported.
export_passphrase_too_short: The passphrase needs at least {min} characters.
export_unreadable_tokens: The access token of {sources} cannot be read with the encryption key of this instance. Enter it again or remove it on the page of the source, then export again.
export_failed: The export failed. Try again; if it fails again, the server log names the reason.
syncs_paused_notice: All syncs are paused; polling checks no source.
source_polling_all_paused: paused for all sources in the settings; only "Sync now" syncs this source
error_docs_url: Enter a web address starting with https:// or http:// under Documentation site, e.g. https://docs.example.com/platform/.
error_docs_url_credentials: The address under Documentation site must not contain a username or password.
query_error_tokens: The token budget must be a positive whole number.
source_preview_no_snippets: This page has no snippets: it holds no text {name} indexes.
apikeys_valid_until: Valid until (optional, the key works through this day)
picker_search: Search sources by name or slug
picker_more: {shown} of {count} shown. Narrow the search to find the others.
apikeys_connect_intro: Connect Claude Code with this key:
apikeys_updated: {name} changed. The key itself stays the same.
apikeys_error_valid_until_past: The date must be today or later.
missed_intro: Search terms agents sent over HTTP or MCP that found nothing, or whose words partly occur in no source, kept for 30 days. Each one is a topic the documentation lacks or names in other words: add it, or use the words agents search for. Words not found are often a missing topic, a typo, or a question in another language than the documentation. A term opens in Try a query. Only searches agents send with an API key count; Try a query on the start page does not. "Found in" names other sources that hold the words: the agent asked the wrong source, so sharpen the short descriptions of both.
missed_none: No query without results in the last 30 days.
dead_links_lead: Links in a page that lead to no page or heading of their source. Fix the link in the repository: once that commit is synced, it leaves this list.
dead_links_none: No source has a dead link.
dead_links_more: {count} more on the Status tab of the source
copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
error_forbidden: You may not open this page.
error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again later.
error_forbidden_admins: This page is for admins only.
auth_reset_link_invalid_ask_admin: This link is invalid, used or expired. Ask an admin for a new one.
login_no_signup: There is no sign-up: an admin invites you.
login_no_signup_providers: Some sign-on providers below also create your account on your first login.
auth_reset_blocked: Too many requests for a new password. Try again later.
auth_reset_link_invalid: This link is invalid, used or expired. Request a new one.
forgot_intro: Enter the email address of your account. If it has one, a link to set a new password is sent there; it is valid for one hour.
forgot_sent: If an account with this address exists, a link to set a new password is on its way.
reset_done: Password set. All sessions of the account have ended.
apikeys_error_source_gone: A selected source no longer exists or you may no longer read it.
field_visibility_internal: Internal: the API key of every user of {name} may search and read this source
field_visibility_public: Public: anyone who can reach {name} may search and read this source without an API key
start_query_intro: Shows what an agent gets back for a question: the same answer as query over HTTP and MCP, across the sources an API key of yours reads; without logging in, the public sources.
apikeys_admin_lead: Every key of every user. Revoke one that leaked or is no longer needed; its owner changes it under My API keys.
requests_none: No requests in the last 90 days
auth_invite_link_invalid: This invitation link is not valid: it was used, replaced by a newer one, withdrawn or is more than 7 days old. Ask an admin to send the invitation again.
auth_account_exists: This email address already has an account.
auth_invitation_exists: An invitation to this address is waiting already; send it again from the list.
invite_intro: Choose a password for your account. You log in with this email address.
invite_sent: Invitation sent to {email}. The link works for 7 days.
invite_link_only: No mail server is set up: send {email} this link yourself. It is shown only now and works for 7 days.
invite_mail_failed: The mail to {email} could not be sent: send this link yourself. It is shown only now and works for 7 days.
users_error_last_admin: The last admin keeps the role: make another user an admin first.
users_error_self: You cannot delete your own account.
users_unlink_consequence_last: It is their only way to log in: afterwards they get in only through a password link you create for them. Every session of theirs ends.
invitations_new_link_title: Create a new invitation link for {email}?
invitations_new_link_consequence: The link created before stops working. No mail server is set up: pass on the new link yourself.
error_source_duplicate: This documentation is already registered as "{name}": same repository and path. A source follows one branch; change the branch there instead of adding another source.
warning_source_overlap: The path overlaps with "{name}": one lies inside the other, so pages under the inner path would be indexed twice. Exclude the directory in the outer source, or save anyway.
field_confirm_overlap: Save anyway, although pages are indexed twice
duplicates_lead: Sources on the same repository and path, whatever their branch, and sources whose paths lie one inside the other: their pages are indexed twice. New ones cannot be created; these existed before or were saved anyway. Delete one of a duplicate, or exclude the inner directory in the outer source of an overlap.
duplicates_none: No two sources hold the same documentation.
setup_import_lead: Choose this when you have an export file from another instance and its passphrase. It brings in the sources, users, API keys and settings; this instance must have no users and no sources. Its admins then log in with their own accounts.
import_no_file: Choose the export file to import.
import_instance_not_empty: This instance has users or sources already; an export is imported only into an empty one.
import_not_an_export: The file is not a grimoire export.
import_newer_version: The export comes from a newer grimoire. Import it into that version or a later one.
import_wrong_passphrase: The passphrase is wrong, or the file was changed or cut short since it was exported.
login_imported: The export is imported. Log in with an account from it; the pages come back with the first sync of each source.
login_imported_refused: These sources cannot sync on this instance: {sources}. The server log names the reason for each.
access_redirected: The Git server redirects this URL elsewhere (HTTP {status}). Use the clone URL from the Clone button of the repository, usually ending in .git; a moved project has a new path.
access_redirected_to: The Git server redirects this URL to {url}. Enter that as Git URL, then test or save again.
field_git_url_hint: The clone URL of the repository, usually ending in .git.
account_providers_lead: Log in through a provider instead of your password. Linking one asks for your password; linking or removing one ends your sessions in other browsers, this one stays logged in.
account_provider_unlinked: The link was removed. Your sessions in other browsers have ended; this one stays logged in.
account_provider_link_needs_password: Linking another provider needs a password: set one first.
auth_oidc_claims: Your account at the identity provider may not log in here. Ask an admin which accounts may.
auth_oidc_email_taken: An account with this email address exists already. Log in with your password, then link the provider under Account. An account without a password gets one through “Forgot your password?”.
auth_oidc_no_email: The identity provider sent no email address, so no account can be created. Ask an admin for an invitation, or link the provider to your account under Account.
auth_oidc_not_allowed: No account can be created for this address. If you have an account here already, log in and link the provider under Account; otherwise ask an admin for an invitation.
auth_oidc_unavailable: Logging in through the identity provider is not possible right now. Try again later or log in with your password.
auth_oidc_misconfigured: Logging in through this identity provider is not set up correctly, and trying again will not help. Tell an admin; until then, log in with your password.
auth_oidc_failed: The login at the identity provider did not complete. Start it again.
auth_oidc_blocked: Too many logins through the identity provider from your network did not complete. Try again in a few minutes or log in with your password.
auth_oidc_identity_taken: This account at the identity provider is linked to another account already.
auth_last_sign_in: This is your only way to log in: set a password or link another provider first.
source_created: Source {name} created. The first sync is running.
source_saved_sync: Source {name} saved. A sync has started.
apikeys_revoke_consequence: Agents using it lose access at once.
invitations_resend_consequence: A new link replaces the one sent before, which stops working.
users_promote_consequence: Admins manage the sources, users, all API keys and the settings of this instance.
users_demote_consequence: They keep their account and their API keys.
users_unlink_consequence: They can no longer log in through it until they link it again, and every session of theirs ends.
users_delete_consequence: Their API keys stop working at once. This cannot be undone.
account_unlink_consequence: You can no longer log in through {provider} until you link it again. Your sessions in other browsers end; this one stays logged in.
source_delete_consequence: Its index goes with it: agents no longer find its pages and snippets. This cannot be undone.
source_public_consequence: Anyone who can reach {instance} may then search and read this source without an API key.
access_path_missing: The path {path} does not exist on branch {branch}.
users_password_link_title: Create a link to set the password of {email}?
users_password_link_consequence: Whoever has the link can set the password of {email} and log in with it, within 24 hours and once. The current password stays valid until then; earlier links stop working.
password_link_sent: Link to set the password sent to {email}.
password_link_created: Link to set the password of {email} created.
password_link_only: No mail server is set up: send {email} this link yourself. It is shown only now and works once, within 24 hours.
password_link_mail_failed: The mail to {email} could not be sent: send this link yourself. It is shown only now and works once, within 24 hours.
account_password_link_mail_failed: The mail to {email} could not be sent. Try again later, or ask an admin for a password link.
switch_failed: Your choice could not be saved. Try again.
